rationale: Executes real stateful SQL queries against disk-synced state files (./data/anarva_sql_service_state.json). Retains data rows permanently across server restarts and browser refreshes.
Executes real MQL queries (find, insertOne, deleteMany) against file-backed JSON document collection service.
Executes real Redis commands (SET, GET, KEYS, DEL, PING) against file-backed key-value store.
LocalStorageProvider creates real bucket directories and writes actual file bytes to local disk (anarva-local-storage/).
Executes real Docker CLI commands if Docker daemon is running; falls back to in-memory status if Docker CLI is absent.
Allocates network CIDR block metadata and persists topology in database repository without mutating Linux kernel network interfaces.
Persists listener rules, health check thresholds, and TLS certificates in database repository without binding live TCP ports.
Copies table state snapshots to ./data/backups/ metadata files.
Generates secure API key hashes, redacts secret upon readback, and revokes credentials upon deletion.
Go background daemon actively reconciles stale/interrupted control-plane operations.
